result.summary: The page layout renders correctly overall, with no clearly broken components or overlapping elements. The main problems are content-related: the promotional banner describes the deliveries as "free" while adding a €10 minimum order, and pricing/discount labels are inconsistently formatted.

issues.description: The promotional banner states "3 free deliveries for you" but also specifies "min. order €10", which is misleading since the deliveries are not actually free without a minimum spend.
issues.suggestion: Clarify the offer wording, e.g. "3 free deliveries on orders over €10", so users understand the minimum-order condition.

issues.description: The delivery-fee labels for the restaurant cards appear to mix formats and signs: "€0.90 delivery" and "€2.40 delivery" read as unusually high positive fees while the list section uses "€0 delivery", and the -20% badge lacks a stated reference price.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the fee format (e.g. "€0.90 delivery fee", "Free delivery") and make discount badges clearer, such as "20% off" or "-20% from €X".
